title: Kyiv Missile Attack Amid Peace Talk Signals

beats.text: Kyiv missiles hit residents, forcing people into shelters as the city faced a sudden overnight attack.
The strike happened on Wednesday night after Moscow signaled it was ready in principle to resume peace talks.
Ukrainian authorities reported that ballistic missiles struck the capital throughout the night.
The attack occurred while the world watched a diplomatic push to end the ongoing war.
US President Donald Trump said negotiations were closer than ever to ending the war following recent meetings.
Envoys met with Vladimir Putin to discuss security guarantees and proposals for an energy ceasefire.
Moscow warned that while it is willing to talk, there is little substance in current proposals.
A new round of trilateral talks is being planned to address these critical security issues.
